issues.description: The 'do 60 minut' quick checklist omits an explicit step to ensure data protection and obtaining participant consent. Previous sections and the context memory explicitly list 'zajistit ochranu dat a získání souhlasů' as a required checklist item for pilots, so this omission creates an inconsistency across the document.
issues.required_fix: Add a clear checklist item in the 60‑minute checklist requiring verification of data protection measures and consent (or use of anonymized test data), with a pointer to follow institutional/privacy policies (cite node 2-6).

issues.description: Several bullets end with the parenthetical marker '(obecná background knowledge)', mixing Czech and English and potentially confusing readers about which statements are evidence‑based versus general advice.
issues.required_fix: Standardize these markers (preferably in Czech) and add a short preface explaining that marked items are general background recommendations rather than citations to source nodes.

issues.description: The quick checklist refers to 'sledovat základní metriky' but doesn't list the concrete recommended chatbot metrics in that checklist entry. The metrics exist elsewhere in the document/memory (počet dotazů, doba odpovědi, procento eskalací, audit odpovědí, spokojenost uživatelů).
issues.required_fix: Explicitly list the recommended chatbot metrics inline in the checklist (and cite node 2-5) so the 60‑minute checklist is actionable without flipping to other sections.

issues.description: The LaTeX body uses mixed-language parenthetical tags and typographic quotes; while not syntactically invalid, these could reduce typesetting consistency or clarity in the compiled document.
issues.required_fix: Replace mixed-language markers with a consistent Czech phrase (e.g., '(obecné pozadí)') and ensure consistent use of ASCII or TeX-safe punctuation for reproducible compilation.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: In the 'Rychlé nastavení „do 60 minut“' enumerate, insert a new first or second item: 'Zajistěte ochranu osobních údajů a získání souhlasů účastníků (nebo použijte anonymizovaná/testovací data). Potvrďte, že konfigurace nástrojů neexfiltruje citlivá data — konzultujte IT/PRIVACY. \cite{2-6}'.

Replace every occurrence of '(obecná background knowledge)' with a single standardized Czech phrase such as '(obecné pozadí)' and add a one-sentence preface before the itemize/enumerate blocks: 'Poznámka: položky označené "(obecné pozadí)" jsou souhrnná doporučení, která nejsou výslovně citována v této sekci.'

Expand checklist item 4 to explicitly name the chatbot metrics: 'Sledujte základní metriky (např. počet dotazů, dobu odpovědi, % eskalací; kvalitativně: audit odpovědí a spokojenost uživatelů) a sepište první poznatky pro další iteraci. \cite{2-5}'.

Consider adding a short caveat (with citation if available) about permissions and backups: 'Před aktivací ověřte práva uživatelů a zálohování kurzu v testovacím prostoru.' If no citation available, mark as '(obecné pozadí)'.

retrieval_queries: Templates or institutional guidance for data protection and consent procedures specific to short educational AI pilots (pilotní souhlasy, anonymizace testovacích dat) — to support checklist wording and citation.
Evidence or guidance references for typical deployment times of simple integrations (webhook/CSV scripts) and LMS plugins — to substantiate phrases like 'nasazení obvykle zabere hodiny'.
Domain-specific pilot KPI templates (e.g., for STEM vs. humanities courses) to address the open thread requesting derived, domain-specific pilot protocols and KPI examples.
